notes: Invented business Burr & Bevel, a mail-in knife sharpening service. One self-contained index.html with inline CSS and JavaScript, no external requests, no build step, system font stacks and a drawn SVG bevel diagram. Seven sections: hero, process, prices, testimonials, owner story, FAQ and a booking form. The form validates each field with specific messages, keeps entered data on error, moves focus to the first problem, saves bookings to localStorage inside try/catch, shows a success state with a reference, and offers a text summary download. If storage is blocked the page says so and the download still works. Bookings never leave the browser. Test status: code-level only. The inline script was syntax-checked, JSON-LD was parsed, and duplicate ids and the single H1 were counted. No browser was available, so layouts at 1440, 768 and 390px, the keyboard path, and reduced-motion behaviour were not observed. Typefaces are system stacks, so they vary by platform.
